text: Hahn is a Lion beer brand: Lion's brand partnership leader Alex Honson announced the Hahn sponsorship of Ripper GC on the brand's behalf.
short: Hahn is a Lion beer brand.

source.name: Mediaweek: Hahn drives partnership with Ripper GC as official sponsor
source.quote: said Alex Honson, brand partnership leader at Lion.
source.note: Honson is quoted announcing the Hahn-Ripper GC partnership; Lion is Hahn's parent company.

additionalSources.name: LIV Golf: Hahn, Ripper GC announce partnership
additionalSources.quote: said Alex Honson, Brand Partnership Leader at Lion.
additionalSources.note: The same spokesperson, identified as Lion's. The page shows only 'NEWS · 8 MONTHS AGO' (opened 2026-10-03); Mediaweek dates the announcement 3 February 2026.
